events.what: Esnault and Groechenig prove the Grothendieck–Katz conjecture for privileged local systems (a generalisation of Katz's physically rigid local systems) on smooth quasi-projective varieties
Lam and Litt prove a non-abelian analogue of the p-curvature conjecture for isomonodromy foliations
Effective version of the already-proved order-one case (Honda) with an algorithm
Movasati reformulation of the conjecture under a stronger hypothesis, withdrawn in v3 and folded into another paper
events.credibility_reason: Withdrawn as a standalone preprint in v3 (Feb 2025).

judgement.doubts: Case vs variant for privileged local systems: they are genuine local systems on smooth varieties, i.e. objects the conjecture quantifies over, so a restriction (case) is the right reading. Fürnsinn–Pannier is an effectivisation of a case already settled before the snapshot, not new movement on this bullet; I scoped it variant rather than the record's 'progress-grade', which does not affect the status.
